svg.title: One neuron: 784 pixels in, one probability out
svg.desc: A 28 by 28 pixel handwritten 9 is flattened into 784 inputs, x1 to x784. Each is multiplied by a weight and summed with a bias b to give z, which the sigmoid function squashes into the probability that the image is a 9.

g.text: One neuron: 784 pixels in, one probability out
Training adjusts the 784 weights and the bias b so P(9) is near 1 for nines and near 0 for every other digit.
